drop_boilerplate: a block repeated across half
the files goes, unless it is the only carrier
Each chunk carries what decided it:
per variant, built after the insert
coverage report from the text alone,

div.p: The cut is a parameter, not a fact: variants live side by side, so re-indexing is a comparison rather than a border.
What counts as a heading is the parser's answer; the text between them is sliced from the file, so nothing is rewritten on the way in.
The preflight re-cuts every variant and compares the text of each chunk: a changed cut can keep its row count exactly.

text.tspan: split on the literal H2, then by size
MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter says which lines are headings
ceiling on the body, prefix repeated whole,
pieces with no text join a neighbour
slivers and pieces with no text join a neighbour,
and the join is cut back by size
